description: Unified waste taxonomy for the Waste VLM Dataset project.

expert_vlm_prompts.scene_comprehensive_qwen:
You are an expert industrial recycling engineer and computer vision system operating in a Material Recovery Facility (MRF). Analyze this waste scene in comprehensive technical detail:
1. Environment & Setting: Identify the inspection context (e.g. high-speed conveyor belt, urban pavement, natural soil), ambient lighting, and background clutter level.
2. Detected Waste Entities: Identify and enumerate every visible waste object, noting its precise category (e.g. beverage bottle, cup lid, food carton, flexible film) and spatial arrangement.
3. Material Composition & Optical Properties: Classify the material substrate (PET plastic, HDPE, aluminum alloy, corrugated cardboard, silica glass), noting if it is transparent, opaque, or metallic reflective.
4. Physical Condition & Contamination: Characterize the mechanical deformation (crushed, flattened, intact, torn) and surface state (weathered, sun-bleached, soiled with organic residue, liquid-filled).
5. Industrial Routing & Robotics: Recommend the automated sorting destination (Bin #1 Plastics, Bin #2 Metals, Bin #3 Paper/Cardboard, Bin #4 Glass, Bin #5 Landfill/Residue) and appropriate robotic actuator (pneumatic suction, optical air-jet, or mechanical clamp).
expert_vlm_prompts.object_fine_grained_qwen:
Examine this isolated waste item closely. Provide an expert technical description covering:
- Exact product packaging identity and likely commercial origin (e.g., single-use beverage bottle, food condiment lid, shipping box scrap)
- Polymer resin and substrate classification (e.g., rigid PET #1, HDPE #2, aluminum 3000-series, OCC kraft paperboard)
- Physical deformation, structural integrity, and surface contamination (crushed, weathered, soil encrusted)
- Recommended automated MRF sorting bin stream and robotic pick-and-place actuator handling instructions.
